srsModule: Module 3 — User Role Management (+ auth/session parts of Module 2)

stories.title: Vitest + RTL test harness

acceptanceCriteria.text: Deps installed: vitest, @vitejs/plugin-react, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/user-event, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom
vitest.config.ts: environment jsdom, setupFiles ['tests/setup.ts'], @/* -> src/* alias
tests/setup.ts wires jest-dom matchers and resets the in-memory store between every test
package.json has 'test' (run once) and 'test:watch' scripts
tests/lib/utils.test.ts smoke test covers formatLKR / formatDate and passes
npm run test passes; npm run build stays green

stories.notes: FE only, no backend. Pinned by docs/testing.md 'First-time setup'. Blocks every other story's verification.

stories.title: Data model & config foundations

acceptanceCriteria.text: src/lib/types.ts: UserStatus includes 'invited'
/admin/users and /admin/staff render an 'Invited' status badge with no row actions until the account is active
.env.example documents NEXT_PUBLIC_FRAPPE_URL, SECRET_COOKIE_PASSWORD, NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_DEMO_LOGIN
epic.md Decisions, accepted-risk, and Backend config checklist sections reviewed and current
npm run build green; no unhandled UserStatus in switch/maps (tsc strict)

stories.notes: Small. Everything downstream depends on the 'invited' status existing.

stories.title: Frappe app scaffold + role & identity model

acceptanceCriteria.text: accreage_mart/api/ package created with auth.py; accreage_mart/utils/profile.py created
Role fixtures Buyer / Seller / Staff / Admin exported in hooks.py; bench migrate recreates them
Buyer Profile DocType: user (Link User, unique), business_name, buyer_type (Select), location, district (Select 25 districts), verified (Check)
Seller Profile DocType: user (Link User, unique), business_name, location, district, description, trust_score (default 0), verified (Check), total_sales (default 0)
DocType field names match src/lib/types.ts shapes (snake_case <-> camelCase mapping documented)
get_user_info returns { user, role, status, verified, profile }; role derived by precedence Admin>Staff>Seller>Buyer; Administrator -> 'admin'; role-less user -> role null
get_user_info does not error for Administrator / role-less / profile-less users
Helper that creates a User sets user_type 'System User', persona role + System Manager, status 'invited'
after_install seeds admin@accreagemart.lk as an Admin (status invited)
Endpoint guard matrix documented in auth.py docstrings

stories.notes: Backend. User runs: bench migrate && bench clear-cache, then bench run-tests --app accreage_mart.

stories.title: Frontend Frappe client plumbing

acceptanceCriteria.text: src/lib/frappe.ts frappeFetch: prefixes NEXT_PUBLIC_FRAPPE_URL + /api/method/, attaches iron-session sid server-side, JSON-encodes body, passes next (tags/revalidate) through
frappeFetch throws Error('Frappe request failed: <status> <body>') on non-2xx
frappeFetch surfaces Frappe 401/403 as a distinct 'session dead' signal callers can act on
src/lib/frappe-error.ts parseFrappeError extracts the human message from _server_messages / exception / message
src/lib/methods.ts AUTH_METHODS enum holds every auth method path; no inline method strings elsewhere
src/lib/tags.ts defines the user/session cache tags as enums

stories.notes: Tests mock global fetch. Server-only module — never imported by a client component.

stories.title: Session + login / logout

acceptanceCriteria.text: src/lib/session.ts: iron-session config, SessionData type, getSession(), ClientSession (omits frappeSid)
app/actions/auth.ts login: zod usr/pwd -> Frappe login -> parse Set-Cookie sid -> store in iron-session -> get_user_info -> redirect to role home
app/actions/auth.ts logout: Frappe logout + destroy iron-session + redirect /login
/login wired to useActionState with the FormState pattern; pending state disables submit
Distinct messages for suspended / deactivated / invited; invited offers 'resend activation link'
Wrong-password and unknown-email return the same generic message (no user enumeration)
?next= is honoured only for same-origin relative paths; //host and absolute URLs are rejected
Authenticated user hitting /login or /register is redirected to their role home
Demo quick-login cards render only when NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_DEMO_LOGIN === 'true'

stories.notes: Tests mock frappeFetch + iron-session. Confirm the real Set-Cookie shape against the running site.

stories.title: Middleware route guard

acceptanceCriteria.text: src/lib/route-guard.ts resolveRoute(session, pathname) is pure and returns {type:'allow'} | {type:'redirect', to}

Public route set + isPublic() covers /, /about, /contact, /marketplace(+/[id]), /auctions(+/[id]), /sellers/[id], /login, /register, /forgot-password, /set-password, /legal/terms, /api/**, static/_next
Protected prefixes /buyer /seller /admin; unauthenticated -> /login?next=<path>
Role/prefix mismatch -> redirect to the user's own role home
suspended / deactivated -> /account/suspended
src/middleware.ts is a thin shell over resolveRoute
/account/suspended explainer page exists
DashboardShell role-guard branch removed; sidebar + sheet + SiteHeader chrome unchanged

stories.notes: resolveRoute is the unit-testable core; middleware.ts itself is not exercised by Vitest (edge runtime).

stories.title: Session-backed identity (retire mock auth-provider)

acceptanceCriteria.text: src/lib/current-user-info.ts: React.cache'd server read of user + profile + primary role
src/hooks/use-current-user.ts useCurrentUser() exposes user / sellerProfile / buyerProfile / logout, matching the old useAuth surface
Initial value is server-rendered so SiteHeader shows no logged-out -> logged-in flash
avatarColor derived from the name, not read from the backend
Every former useAuth importer (~15 files) migrated to useCurrentUser()
src/components/providers/auth-provider.tsx deleted; AuthProvider removed from src/app/layout.tsx
Mock-dashboard bridge: real session resolves to fixed mock identity per role (buyer->u-buyer-1, seller->u-seller-1, staff->u-staff, admin->u-admin); documented as tech debt
npm run build green; existing mock dashboards still render for each role

stories.notes: Highest-blast-radius FE story. Do the useAuth sweep as one mechanical pass and lean on tsc + build.

stories.title: Set-password flow + branded transactional email

acceptanceCriteria.text: Accreage Mart logo asset (SVG + PNG) added under accreage_mart/public/ and referenced by the FE
One parameterised HTML email base (agri-green header, 600px single column, amber CTA, footer with expiry note) + plain-text alternative
Three variants render correctly: buyer/seller welcome, staff invite, password reset
frappe.sendmail wrapper sends the templated mail
/set-password?key= page: password + confirm, policy enforced (min 8, >=1 letter, >=1 number, != email/local-part/name, zxcvbn >= 2), inline FormState errors
set_password(key, pwd): validates key, sets password, flips status invited->active, single-use, then auto-login to role home
request_password_reset(email): allow_guest, rate-limited, always returns the generic 'if an account exists' response
resend_activation(email): allow_guest, rate-limited, same generic response, only (re)sends for status 'invited'
Reset/activation key expiry read from site config; expired or used key -> clear error on /set-password
Dev fallback: with no SMTP configured the endpoints include the /set-password URL in the JSON response and the UI shows a 'continue here' link
/forgot-password stub wired to request_password_reset with a 'check your email' state

stories.notes: SMTP delivery NOT required to pass — dev link path must work end to end. Shared by 1.9 / 1.10 / 1.11.

stories.title: Buyer registration

acceptanceCriteria.text: register_buyer: creates User (status 'invited', roles Buyer + System Manager) + Buyer Profile (verified false), triggers welcome email
register_buyer is allow_guest and rate-limited
/register buyer branch wired to a register server action; zod validates full name, business name, email, mobile, district enum, buyer type enum, terms checkbox; no password field
Terms checkbox links to a placeholder /legal/terms page
Mobile is stored without uniqueness enforcement (buyer + seller may share a number)
Success shows a 'check your email' state (no auto-login yet)
Duplicate email, existing account still 'invited' -> resend activation link
Duplicate email, existing active account -> 'account exists, sign in instead'
After set-password the buyer lands on /buyer and is not gated by verified

stories.notes: Depends on 1.8. Buyer gating decision: activated buyers transact immediately (epic Decisions 3).

stories.title: Seller registration + pending gate

acceptanceCriteria.text: register_seller: creates User (status 'invited', roles Seller + System Manager) + Seller Profile (verified false, trust_score 0), triggers welcome email
register_seller is allow_guest and rate-limited
/register seller branch wired: common fields, no buyer type, optional short business description
resolveRoute: activated + unverified seller on /seller/** (except /seller/profile) -> /seller/pending
/seller/pending minimal page explains staff verification is in progress
Verified seller passes straight through to /seller
Seller login lands on /seller or /seller/pending per verified state

stories.notes: The pending gate is only demonstrable once 1.13 (or Frappe desk) can flip verified.

stories.title: Staff & admin provisioning

acceptanceCriteria.text: /register never exposes staff or admin (asserted by a test)
create_staff: caller must be Admin or Administrator, else 403
create_staff: creates User (status 'invited', role Staff or Admin + System Manager), triggers the staff-invite email; no temp password is returned
/admin/staff 'Add staff member' dialog wired to create_staff via a server action
resolveRoute: /admin/staff and /admin/users restricted to Admin / Administrator; Staff may use other /admin pages
Administrator resolves to 'admin' and lands on /admin
setUserStatus wired to User.enabled + status (suspend / reactivate) from /admin/staff and /admin/users

stories.notes: Depends on 1.8. First admin comes from 1.3 after_install seed or Frappe Administrator.

stories.title: Epic acceptance & manual E2E script

acceptanceCriteria.text: epic.md gains a step-by-step manual E2E script: register -> receive link (or dev link) -> set password -> auto-login -> guard check, for buyer, seller, staff, admin
Frappe Activity Log confirmed to record login, failed login, password reset, staff creation
All stories 1.1-1.11 (and 1.13 if in scope) have every acceptance criterion done and a filled verify block
Epic status set to done in stories.json and in docs/epics/README.md

stories.notes: No automated tests — this is the close-out/roll-up story. Playwright is not set up.

stories.title: Account approvals screen

acceptanceCriteria.text: Admin surface lists active-but-unverified buyers and sellers (reusing existing approvals-queue components)
'Approve' action calls verify_account(user); Staff/Admin only
verify_account sets profile.verified = true and creates a notification for the user
Approving a seller immediately lifts the /seller/pending gate for that account

stories.notes: In scope per epic Decisions 7. If dropped, verified is flipped via Frappe desk and this moves to Epic 02.
